answer: The reef counter is kept in dawn and glacier exposes each reset. An farming party hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The per-identity price is 108 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
